name: Model Monitoring, Explainability & Drift Detection
description: Production model observability: detecting Data Drift, Concept Drift, prediction drift, statistical divergence (PSI, KS-test), explainable AI (SHAP, LIME), performance decay, and automated alerting.

subskills.name: Data Drift & Covariate Shift Detection
subskills.description: Detecting distribution shifts in input features P(X), Kolmogorov-Smirnov test (KS-test), Population Stability Index (PSI), and Wasserstein distance.

subskills.name: Concept Drift & Prior Shift P(Y|X) / P(Y)
subskills.description: Detecting relationship shifts between features and targets P(Y|X), prior probability shifts P(Y), sudden vs gradual vs seasonal drift.

subskills.name: Drift Monitoring Frameworks (Evidently AI, whylogs)
subskills.description: Automated drift reports and test suites in Evidently AI, statistical data profiling with whylogs, and real-time dashboarding.

subskills.name: SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations) & Feature Attribution
subskills.description: Game-theoretic Shapley values, TreeSHAP, KernelSHAP, summary plots, waterfall plots, dependence plots, and local/global explainability.

subskills.name: LIME (Local Interpretable Model-agnostic Explanations)
subskills.description: Perturbation-based local surrogate models, interpretable feature representations, and explaining individual black-box predictions.

subskills.name: Performance Decay & Delayed Ground Truth Handling
subskills.description: Tracking metrics with delayed labels, proxy performance estimation (NannyML), confidence degradation, and business impact estimation.

subskills.name: Out-of-Distribution (OOD) & Adversarial Input Detection
subskills.description: Mahalanobis distance, energy-based OOD scores, detecting corrupted/adversarial payloads before feeding into model inference.

subskills.name: Model Fairness, Disparate Impact & Bias Auditing
subskills.description: Demographic parity, Equalized Odds, disparate impact ratio, Fairlearn / AIF360, and auditing protected attributes.

subskills.name: ML Alerting Rules & Automated Incident Response
subskills.description: Defining metric threshold alert rules in Prometheus/Grafana, automated fallback model triggering, and retraining pipeline invocation.

cv.signal: Implemented real-time data drift monitoring with Evidently AI and integrated SHAP explainability into production APIs

linkedin.signal: Model Monitoring, Explainable AI (SHAP), and Data Drift endorsements

assessment.signal: Passes Model Monitoring, Explainability & Drift Detection Assessment

junior.description: Computes KS-test and PSI for drift, generates SHAP/LIME explanation plots for stakeholder transparency.

mid.description: Configures Evidently AI test suites, tracks performance with delayed labels, and conducts bias audits using Fairlearn.

senior.description: Architects Out-of-Distribution (OOD) protection gates and implements automated alerting with fallback model routing.
